title: Homotopy minimal periods for fiber maps on circle bundles over circle
summary: Given a fiber bundle $Y\rightarrow M\xrightarrow{p}B$ and a fiber map $f: M\rightarrow M$ over $B$, we introduce the notion of fiberwise homotopy minimal periods, denoted by $H_BPer(f).$ This invariant records the periods that occur among representatives of the fiberwise homotopy class of $f.$ We investigate the case in which both the base and the fiber are circles. Up to isomorphism, the corresponding total spaces are the torus and the Klein bottle.
